description: Live availability at one campsite for a stay and party. Returns the accommodation types that can take the party with the total price and the amount due at checkout, and explains why the others cannot (fully booked, minimum stay, adults only, no dogs).

campsite.description: The campsite slug, as returned by search_campsites.

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check_in.

children.description: Number of children. Which ages count as a child varies by campsite: see age_policy on get_campsite (default: everyone under 18).

infants.description: Number of infants, only at campsites whose age_policy has infants_under_age. Infants are never charged.

name: check_availability
title: Check availability
